title: A Balanced Diet and Deficiency Diseases
summary: The food groups, planning a balanced thali, and what happens when nutrients are missing.

ib.note: Energy requirements and BMI appear in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body

objectives: I can describe a balanced diet and plan one using the food groups.
I can link deficiency diseases to missing nutrients.
I can evaluate diets and suggest improvements.
misconceptions: A balanced diet means eating the same amount of everything.
If you feel full, you're well nourished.
Only poor people suffer from nutrient deficiencies.
